summary: AGL Private Credit Income Fund files 8-K regarding a second amended and restated LLC agreement for AGL Enhanced PC Income I LLC, admitting AIMCo and additional Vintage Strategies vehicles as members. Vintage Strategies transferred $54M of interests; AIMCo acquired 13.64% and Joining Vintage Strategies Members acquired 4.33%. This is a routine investment vehicle membership change with no acquisition, divestiture, or control event. No premium, price per share, or deal timeline stated. Not a special situation.
